title: Idempotency keys ignored on retried refunds
body: A merchant retried a refund call after a timeout and got two refunds. The Idempotency-Key header is read, but the lookup runs before the refund row is committed, so two concurrent requests both miss it.

comments.author: aria
comments.text: Reproduced with two parallel requests. Moving the key insert into the same transaction with a unique constraint.

comments.author: aria
comments.text: Fixed: unique index on (merchant_id, idempotency_key), second request now returns the first response. Backfilled the two duplicate refunds with finance.

title: Tokenization endpoint returns 500 for Amex test cards
body: While testing the new card iframe for Project Atlas, every Amex test number comes back with a 500 from /v2/tokens. Visa and Mastercard are fine.

comments.author: cora
comments.text: The Luhn check is fine; the length validator assumes 16 digits. Amex is 15.

comments.author: cora
comments.text: Length check now uses the BIN range table. Added Amex, Diners and UnionPay test numbers to the contract tests.

title: Connection pool exhaustion during settlement batch
body: Settlement batch at 02:00 UTC made charge requests time out for about six minutes. Pool metrics show all 40 connections busy, most of them held by the settlement export.

comments.author: nora
comments.text: Settlement export and live charges share one pool. Splitting them: separate pool of 10 for batch work, live traffic keeps 40.

comments.author: nora
comments.text: Deployed. Last night's batch ran with zero charge timeouts.

title: Remove raw PAN fragments from payments-api debug logs
body: Log sampling found the first 12 digits of card numbers in DEBUG-level request logs for the charge route. This is a PCI finding and has to be fixed before the evidence deadline.

comments.author: gwen
comments.text: Logs older than 7 days are already purged. Please confirm the retention on the debug index.

comments.author: cora
comments.text: Request body logging removed for charge and token routes, redaction filter added at the logger, and the debug index purged. Evidence attached for Gwen.

title: 3DS challenge timeout too aggressive on mobile networks
body: Conversion on mobile dropped after the 3DS change. Many challenges expire at 60 seconds while the bank app is still opening.

comments.author: aria
comments.text: Raised the challenge window to 180 s, which is what the card schemes allow. Abandonment back to the old level in the first day.

title: Rate limiter double-counts webhook replays
body: When a processor replays webhooks after an outage, each replay counts against the merchant's API rate limit, and some merchants get 429s on their own calls.

comments.author: nora
comments.text: Webhook ingestion should use its own bucket. Drafting the change now.

title: Invoice PDF generation stalls on accounts with 5k+ line items
body: Monthly invoice emails for the three largest accounts went out a day late. The PDF renderer runs out of memory and the job retries until the queue gives up.

comments.author: ben
comments.text: Renderer builds the whole table in memory. Switching to paged rendering, 500 lines per page.

comments.author: ben
comments.text: Paged renderer shipped. Largest account's invoice now renders in 9 s using 180 MB.

title: Retry schedule for failed card renewals is too short
body: Renewals that fail with soft declines are retried three times in 24 hours, then the subscription is cancelled. Industry practice is to spread retries over a week or more.

comments.author: ben
comments.text: Pairing on this one. Proposed schedule: day 1, 3, 5, 7, with a dunning email before the last attempt.

comments.author: aria
comments.text: New schedule is live behind a flag at 100%. Recovered renewals up 11% in the first week of data.

title: Consumer lag on ledger-events after broker restart
body: Reconciliation consumer group sat at 300k lag for two hours after broker 3 was restarted. No errors, it just stopped making progress.

comments.author: vik
comments.text: Group is stuck in PreparingRebalance; one member has a session timeout far above max.poll.interval. Asked the ledger team to restart that pod.

comments.author: vik
comments.text: Lag cleared. Added a consumer-config lint to the deploy checks so the timeouts can't be set that far apart again.

title: Upgrade Kafka brokers to 3.8
body: We are two minor versions behind and the next security patch only ships for 3.8. Rolling upgrade, one broker per day, in the Tuesday change window.

comments.author: wes
comments.text: Brokers 1-3 done, no under-replicated partitions during the roll.

comments.author: wes
comments.text: All five brokers on 3.8. Inter-broker protocol bumped, clients unaffected.

title: Schema registry rejects backward-compatible Avro change
body: Adding an optional field to FeatureUpdated is rejected by the registry even though it has a default.

comments.author: wes
comments.text: The subject was set to FULL_TRANSITIVE by mistake when it was created. Switched to BACKWARD to match the rest of the topics; your schema registers now.

title: Dead-letter topic retention set to 1 hour
body: orders.dlq messages disappear before anyone can look at them. The Terraform module default for retention is 3600000 ms.

comments.author: vik
comments.text: DLQ topics now default to 14 days in platform-modules/kafka. Applied in the change window.

title: Reindex job OOMs on catalog shard 7
body: Full reindex failed three nights running. Shard 7 holds the marketplace sellers with huge variant lists and the job pod gets OOMKilled at 8 GiB.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: Bulk requests were sized by document count, not bytes. Switched to 10 MB byte-sized batches; shard 7 reindexes at 3.1 GiB peak now.

title: Synonym file not reloaded after deploy
body: Added 'sneakers => trainers' synonyms, deploy succeeded, but queries still don't match until a manual close/open of the index.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: Synonyms are now in an updateable search-time filter, and the deploy step calls the reload API. No more close/open.

title: Stale results after product price change
body: Customers see old prices in search results for up to an hour after a merchant updates them, while the product page is already correct.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: The updater consumes catalog-updates in 5-minute micro-batches but price events were landing in the low-priority lane.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: Price and stock events now go to the fast lane. Median staleness is 8 seconds.

title: Query latency p99 regression after analyzer change
body: p99 query latency went from 120 ms to 310 ms after the new analyzer was enabled for 10% of traffic.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: The new analyzer emits shingles on every field, including descriptions. Limiting shingles to title and brand.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: p99 back to 125 ms with the analyzer at 100%. Relevance metrics unchanged from the flag test.

title: Index alias swap leaves orphaned shards
body: After each blue/green reindex the old index is kept, and the cluster has 14 orphaned indices taking 1.2 TB.

comments.author: tara
comments.text: Adding a cleanup step that deletes indices older than the previous two generations after the alias swap succeeds.

title: Duplicate ledger events emitted by the Kafka consumer
body: Finance found a settlement counted twice in yesterday's reconciliation. The reconciliation consumer applied the same LedgerEntryPosted events twice after a rebalance. Third occurrence this quarter.

comments.author: vik
comments.text: The consumer commits offsets after applying the batch, so a rebalance in between replays it. Tuning helps, but the write and the publish can still disagree.

comments.author: omar
comments.text: Short term: dedupe guard keyed on entry id in the consumer. Long term I want the ledger write and the event in one Postgres transaction with an outbox.

comments.author: omar
comments.text: Dedupe guard shipped and the duplicate settlement was reversed. Outbox proposal is going into ADR-012.

title: Outbox relay backlog alert thresholds
body: With ADR-012 the relay publishes from the outbox table. We need an alert on the age of the oldest unsent row and a retention job for sent rows.

title: Terraform state lock stuck on prod workspace
body: A CI job was cancelled mid-apply and the prod state is still locked. Every plan fails with 'Error acquiring the state lock'.

comments.author: gus
comments.text: Confirmed no apply is running, force-unlocked, ran a clean plan with no drift. CI now runs applies with a lock timeout and a cleanup step on cancel.

title: Node pool autoscaler not scaling down
body: General pool sits at 38 nodes overnight even though utilisation is under 20%.

comments.author: eli
comments.text: Several pods use local emptyDir without the safe-to-evict annotation, so the autoscaler won't drain their nodes.

comments.author: eli
comments.text: Annotations added via the Helm defaults, scale-down delay set to 15 min in the Terraform module. Overnight count is now 17 nodes.

title: Rotate cluster CA before expiry
body: The production cluster CA expires on 2026-10-20. Nobody had it on a calendar; security's certificate scan found it.

comments.author: gus
comments.text: Plan: rotate in staging first, then prod in two Tuesday windows (control plane, then kubelets).

comments.author: gus
comments.text: Rotation finished in prod. New CA valid to 2031. Added expiry checks for every cluster cert to the alerting.

title: Ingress controller 502s during rolling deploys
body: Every deploy of the search API produces a short burst of 502s from the ingress, about 0.3% of requests for 20 seconds.

comments.author: eli
comments.text: Pods were removed from endpoints after SIGTERM, not before. Added a preStop sleep of 10 s and connection draining on the ingress. No 502s in the last three deploys.

title: Fraud model drift alert firing every weekend
body: FraudModelDrift pages every Saturday and Sunday. No change in fraud rates, so it looks like the alert, not the model.

comments.author: hana
comments.text: PSI was computed against a weekday baseline. Baselines are now per day-of-week. Last two weekends had no false pages in replay.

title: Retrain fraud model with chargeback labels
body: The model trains on manual review outcomes only. Chargebacks arrive 30-90 days later but are the better label. Join them in and retrain.

comments.author: ivan
comments.text: Label join done with a 90-day maturity window; training set is 18% smaller but cleaner.

comments.author: ivan
comments.text: New model promoted after 72 h shadow scoring. AUC +0.03 on holdout, false positives down 9% at the same recall.

title: Backfill merchant velocity features for 2025
body: The retrain in ML-33 needs merchant velocity features going back to January 2025, but the offline copy only starts in March 2026.

comments.author: jun
comments.text: Backfilled from the raw payment events in the warehouse. Verification sampled 1% of keys, 0.02% mismatch from late refunds, which is expected.

title: Shadow-score candidate fraud model on checkout traffic
body: The device-signal candidate needs at least a week of shadow scores on real checkout traffic before we compare it with production.

comments.author: hana
comments.text: Shadow scoring is running at 100% of traffic since this morning. First comparison on 2026-10-21.

title: Push notification delivery delays on Android
body: Order-shipped pushes reach Android devices 5 to 20 minutes late, iOS is fine. Started after the 5.12 mobile release went to staged rollout.

comments.author: pia
comments.text: We send with normal priority, and Android batches those under Doze. Testing high priority for transactional pushes only.

comments.author: bea
comments.text: Quinn is taking over notification-service, so please loop him in on anything new here.

comments.author: quinn
comments.text: Following along. High-priority test on 5% of Android devices shows median delay under 4 seconds.

title: Email template rendering breaks with emoji in subject
body: Marketing's subject line with an emoji shows up as question marks in Outlook.

comments.author: pia
comments.text: Subjects were not RFC 2047 encoded. Now encoded as UTF-8 B-words; tested in Outlook, Gmail and Apple Mail.

title: Sessions not revoked on password reset
body: After a password reset, existing refresh tokens keep working for up to 30 days. Found during the internal pen test.

comments.author: uma
comments.text: Password reset now bumps the user's token generation, and refresh checks it. All other sessions are revoked immediately. Regression test added.

title: SAML metadata refresh fails silently
body: An enterprise customer rotated their IdP signing cert and SSO broke for them. Our metadata refresh had been failing for a week without an alert.

comments.author: gwen
comments.text: Refresh errors now raise an alert per connection, and we keep the previous cert valid for 72 h during rotation.

title: Nightly warehouse load misses late-arriving events
body: Daily revenue in BI is 0.4% lower than finance's numbers. The nightly load cuts off at midnight and events that arrive a few minutes late are never picked up.

comments.author: dev
comments.text: Load now waits 30 minutes past midnight and re-merges the previous two days. BI and finance match to the cent for the last four days.

title: Checkout form double-submits on slow networks
body: On 3G throttling, tapping 'Pay' twice creates two payment intents. The second one is declined, but customers see a scary error.

comments.author: kai
comments.text: Button disables on first submit and the client sends a stable idempotency key per checkout session, so a second request returns the first result.

title: Mobile app crashes on card scan with Android 11
body: Crash reports from 5.12 beta: opening the card scanner crashes on Android 11 devices, about 2% of beta sessions.

comments.author: zane
comments.text: Camera permission callback ran after the fragment was detached. Guarded it and added a fallback to manual entry. Fixed in 5.12.1.
